Bakery

What Fika bakes and serves

From the photos, the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Sourdough bread

One guest calls the sourdough the best they have ever had, with a crisp crust. On request the loaf is sliced for you.

Croissants and pastries

17 reviews mention the croissants, 3 the cheesecake, 3 hazelnut, 2 the banoffee tart and 2 the raspberry croissant.

Breakfast, pizza and wine

Guests recommend it for breakfast and praise the focaccia sandwich. The Instagram profile lists coffee, pizza and wine as well.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Friendly staff

9 Google reviews mention the friendly staff. One guest calls them very kind and helpful.

Come early

One guest writes that it is popular and busy at weekends and recommends coming early. The bakery opens at 7:00.

A lovely atmosphere

2 reviews mention the cosy atmosphere. One guest says the bakery is definitely worth a visit in Larnaca.

On Athinon Avenue

At Athinon Avenue 32 in Finikoudes, Larnaca. Google lists the opening hours as every day 7:00-23:00; the Instagram profile says open from 7:00 until sold out. Messages via Instagram.

What guests say

Three of 114 Google reviews, 93 of them with five stars.
